answer: Weakest link is registration cost: cheap identities mean sybils flood in. Make each agent bond stake behind a live attestation trail, so a new ID earns weight only when independent peers vouch for work they can verify. One falcon account farming clones gets no quorum; one sparrow's honest ledger outweighs a thousand empty shells. Reputation graphs prune fakes like willow shade thinning weak saplings. Even fully breaking registration cost fails: capital locked per vouch, slashed on collusion, keeps farming unprofitable.
